additionalPlain:
A few words about us:
IDT Corporation is a global communications company founded in 1990 and headquartered in Newark, New Jersey. We are industry leaders in prepaid communication and payment services and one of the largest international voice carriers. We are listed on the NYSE, employ over 1800 people across 20 countries, and have over $1.5 billion in revenues. 
We are not ”another big IT corporation”— we encourage and support in-house entrepreneurs in developing their ideas into business actions.
Our National Retail Solutions brandprovides a sales management system and POS equipment to small and medium-sized businesses. With the help of NRS, business owners can solve a management problem: the product includes integrated advertising, data analysis, and payment processing.

descriptionPlain:
About the Role:    
Our National Retail Solutions brand is a highly successful Point-of-Sale (POS) SaaS business, rapidly expanding into new sectors with over 40,000 software and hardware terminals in independent retailers like: convenience stores, bodegas, liquor stores, small grocers, and tobacco shops. 
We’re looking for a highly technical, hands-in-code Engineering Manager, with experience building highly scalable and robust systems who wants to focus on:
1. Team Building: Hiring, Coaching, Firing.
2. Engineering Process: Agentic Development.
3. Technical Leadership.
You’ll work cross-functionally with engineering, design, operations, go-to-market teams, and executive leadership to create intuitive, scalable products that solve real operational challenges for our customers.
This is an opportunity to build meaningful products from the ground up in a fast-moving environment where customer empathy, speed, and product quality matter.

descriptionPlain:
IDT is looking for a professional who'll help our Engineering Teams build and deploy code better,  faster and secure.
 
In this role you will:
 
- Support, maintain and upgrade Kubernetes clusters, Jenkins, SonarQube, Artifactory solutions and other related infrastructure and tools.
- Use Infrastructure-as-Code tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, AWS CDK, etc.
- Implement and test High Availability, Fault Tolerance, Backup and Disaster Recovery strategies, Monitoring and Alerting
- Provide support to global development and infrastructure teams, troubleshooting CI/CD pipelines and deployments.
- Identify and address issues, including cost and security in both AWS and on-premises environments.
